notes.title: ver 1.1.2 ( 1.1.0 - 1.1.2 ) patch notes
notes.content:
1.1.2 ( 1.1.0 - 1.1.2 ) patch notes

[b]<Features>[/b]
Add item to change the size of the stage depending on the number of players.
　L It is possible to separate stages for 1v1 (stages before ver 1.0.1) and larger stages for 3 or more players. (It is also possible to always set the stage for 1v1 in the room settings)
Enter any name you like (only the first time you start the game, the Steam name is set)


[b]<Adjustments>[/b]
The player's movement becomes slow (slower than while charging) after the charge is completed.
The size of bullets has been uniformly increased (hit box has not been changed).
The size of the character has been increased (hit box is unchanged).
The appearance of the player's hit points was made closer to the actual size (hit box were not changed).
Changed the color of the step count UI displayed near the player to green.
Adjustment of hit collision on some walls in the castle stage
Adjusted the time for reinforcement over time
Adjusted the lighting of some maps.
Adjustment of Score Attack mode (CPU battle)
　L The stage is now wider.
  L Changed when CPU spawns
  　  L Changed spawn position
　　L Effects now appear when spawning
　　L Added lag until skill use after spawning
　L Adjusted achievement values for some bonus scores
L Adjustment of freeze-frame
L Adjusted timing of bullet speed increase over time
L Adjustment of skills
L Adjustment of character

[b]<Bug fixes/QOL changes>[/b].
Added a sound when "AreYouReady" is displayed.
・Added a notification UI when a beginner mission is ready to receive.
Changed back button during match from mouse click to Esc key long press.
Fixed a bug that the sound of the sound of the Servant's squeal remains in the preview.
Fixed a bug that the sound of the sound of the Servant's cry remains while it is showing victory.
Fixed a bug that the damage judgment of the Servant remains.
. Fixed a bug in the focus circle.
Fixed a bug when using blade spinner near a wall.
Fixed a bug that the cool time does not start if the player is hit after blinking.
Fixed a bug that caused the controller to vibrate when an enemy player glazes.
Fixed a bug with skill unlock.
　L The unlock saving method has been changed. If you played before ver 1.0.1, you will be given a key according to the number of skills you opened last time after the update.
Fixed a bug that some trees and buildings in the stage are hidden.
Fixed a bug that score attack bonuses are added in duplicate.
Fixed spawn synchronization of players.
Fixed a bug that players spawn when leaving a room.
Fixed a bug with Chinese font.

notes.title: ver 1.0.1 patch notes
notes.content:
ver 1.0.1 patch notes

[b] <Features>[/b]
Rooms with matches in progress are also displayed in the list.
 L Elapsed time from the start of a match is indicated

[b]<Bug fixes/QOL changes>[/b]
Get Steam name (You can temporarily change the name by typing it in. 12 character limit is set.)
Fixed a bug that player level (experience gauge) does not increase.
Fixed a bug that the ready button is not selected after a rematch when using a controller.
Fixed a bug that the player can move while accumulating charge attacks.
Fixed a bug that Ready of other players is not synchronized correctly.
Fixed a bug that the client rematches when the host leaves the room while the host is waiting.
Fixed a bug that AimAssist will point to the exiting player if the player exits the room during a match.
Adjusted the position of the close button in the room search.
Fixed a problem that the win direction is not visible depending on the ratio of the win direction.
Fixed a bug that the controller type returns to the PlayStation setting.
Fixed a bug that the stamps that were present from the beginning are not displayed correctly on the home screen when the game is launched for the first time.
Adjusted the sound of crates breaking.
